name: Pokemon Manager
description: PKHeX-powered save manager: move Pokémon between games, perform trade evolutions, and inject Mystery Gifts, Mystery Events and e-Reader cards.
author: ProClifo

changelog.v0.2.48: Gen 2 Mystery Gift: "Sorry—only five gifts a day." after the fifth gift.
changelog.v0.2.49: Save states are backed up to PokemonManager/Backups instead of deleted. Backups keep the last 32 saves and 32 save states per game. Save state settings removed.
changelog.v0.2.51: Player sprites for Black/White and Black 2/White 2 saves on the saves list.
changelog.v0.2.52: English Black/White and Black 2/White 2 ROMs no longer show Japanese names. Anbernic H700 build uses NextUI v6.15.0.
